turns.answer_text:
The useful reference points containing only the permitted elements are:

- `Y0.6Ca0.4Ba1.2La0.8Cu3O7.15`, Tc = 67 K  
- `Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O10`, Tc = 110 K  

After normalization, linearly blending these endpoints gives an estimated Tc of 90 K when the 110 K composition has weight

\[
w=\frac{90-67}{110-67}=0.534884.
\]

The resulting fractions sum to approximately 1 and remain within all specified ranges. This is an interpolation heuristic; the actual response may be nonlinear, but it uses the closest relevant lower-Tc composition and the allowed high-Tc Bi cuprate.
